Illusive Mirage — Cursed Technique Reversal

Due to your mastery of Reverse Cursed Technique, you have learned your cursed technique reversal. You are now able to make the distorted faces real. As an action for 4 cursed energy, you can distort a creature's face that is distorted for a cursed creature. The creature must make a CE saving throw. On a failure, their face is distorted and they have disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma checks and saves and lose concentration on any technique or feature it was concentrating on. After failing, a creature may repeat the saves at the end of their turns, ending the effect on a success.
